import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and aggregate one mean AQI per city.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
city_avg = df.groupby('city')['aqi'].mean()
overall_avg = df['aqi'].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
ax.bar(city_avg.index, city_avg.values, color='steelblue', label='City average AQI')
ax.axhline(overall_avg, color='darkorange', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
           label=f'Overall average AQI ({overall_avg:.1f})')
ax.set_ylabel('Average AQI')
ax.set_title('Average AQI by City')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(city_avg.max(), overall_avg) * 1.12)
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
